findings.highlight: it’s completely isolated during the winter
findings.evidenceJa: 冬場は閑古鳥が鳴くお正月の商店街だ
findings.governingReading: in winter it is a New Year shopping street where only the cuckoo of desolation cries
findings.explanation: The comic comparison that characterizes the deserted rooftop disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなんでいまさら済まされないけど
findings.governingReading: I know that does not make up for it now
findings.explanation: Rin’s admission that the Command Spell cannot settle her responsibility becomes an opaque claim that it is “nothing.”

findings.evidenceJa: 浮ついていた意識が止まる
findings.governingReading: My fluttering attention comes to an abrupt stop
findings.explanation: The sudden collapse of Shirou’s excited self-consciousness into seriousness is flattened into generic thought stoppage.

findings.highlight: I almost fell for Caster’s trap
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの手に落ちかけた
findings.governingReading: I nearly fell into Caster’s hands
findings.explanation: Near capture and control by Caster becomes merely falling for a trap.

findings.highlight: Your body was already too mature
findings.evidenceJa: もう二次成長期あとでしょ
findings.governingReading: you were already past your second growth phase
findings.explanation: A specific developmental threshold for bodily alteration becomes vague maturity.

findings.highlight: this is her part of her as a magus
findings.evidenceJa: それが魔術師として一人前である遠坂らしさ
findings.governingReading: that is characteristic of Tohsaka as a fully fledged magus
findings.explanation: The sentence is grammatically broken and loses the qualification that Rin is fully fledged.

findings.highlight: implant it bit by bit from the time we’re born
findings.evidenceJa: 子供の頃から少しずつ移植していく
findings.governingReading: implant it little by little from childhood
findings.explanation: The stated start in childhood is shifted to birth.

findings.evidenceJa: なんでそこに俺が出て来るんだ？
findings.governingReading: Why am I being brought into this?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s confusion at Rin equating their lives becomes confusion about being asked a question.

findings.evidenceJa: 辛いとも厳しいとも感じなかった
findings.explanation: Two different dimensions are rendered as near-synonyms, obscuring why Shirou resembles Rin only partially.

findings.highlight: I want to be like Kiritsugu someday
findings.evidenceJa: いつか切嗣のような人間になる
findings.governingReading: Someday, I would become a person like Kiritsugu
findings.explanation: A stated formative resolve is softened into present desire.

findings.highlight: came to where you are today with your own skill
findings.explanation: Rin praises Shirou for teaching himself; the English instead praises an undefined personal skill.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka tells me to be proud
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を張って、遠坂はそう言った
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka said it with her chest proudly raised
findings.explanation: Rin’s proud posture and personal delight are reassigned as an instruction for Shirou to display pride.

findings.evidenceJa: 左手を突き出してくる
findings.explanation: The location of Rin’s displayed crest shifts from hand to the broader arm.

findings.highlight: We cannot create anything special with just magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力だけで神秘は起こせない
findings.governingReading: Magical energy alone cannot bring about Mystery
findings.explanation: A Fate-specific metaphysical claim is reduced to the vague phrase “anything special.”

findings.highlight: I can store things other than magical energy as well
findings.evidenceJa: 移し替えられるのは魔力だけじゃない
findings.governingReading: magical energy is not the only thing I can transfer
findings.explanation: Rin’s broader transfer capability is changed into broader storage capability, altering the function of her Conversion.
Inheriting the Tohsaka magecraft line is mistranslated as achieving success.
